      • setForPassword

        public TypedCommandQuery setForPassword(String forPassword)
        Sets the specification of the password for which the query shall be executed. The query returns data depending on this password.
        Parameters:
        forPassword - A string which identifies a password in same manner as it can be entered in a data field with type "P12:11". This might be a id string, ident number, search word or even a "$-selection".
        Returns:
        This object.
